build_ace_dataset_iterator: build an ACE dataset iterator that yields ACESentence objects from CONLL-formatted files
create_ace_document_iterator: create an ACE document iterator that yields lists of ACESentence objects from a CONLL file
test_ace_sentence_iterator: test the ACE sentence iterator that yields individual sentences from a CONLL-formatted file
refactor_ace_coref_parser: refactor the ACE coref span parser to handle overlapping coreference spans with nested cluster ids
review_ace_conll_parser: review the ACE CONLL parser that converts CoNLL rows into ACESentence objects with entity mentions and relations
